column1: # The offline steps of .forgejo/workflows/checks.yaml that .githooks/pre-push runs, picked by changed path.
# Columns, tab separated: <changed-path regex (ERE)> <tool the step needs, or -> <command, verbatim from checks.yaml>
# "." runs on every push. A step whose tool is missing on this machine is skipped with a line saying so; CI still runs it.
# A row whose regex is "-" never runs here: its CI step needs a container this machine lacks (nut-replay: Debian's nut packages).
# scripts/check-prepush-steps.py fails CI when a single-line step of checks.yaml has no row here, or a row has no step there.
